sloka: हर्षेणापूर्यमाणो ऽसौ रम्ये पर्वतनिर्झरे ।छिन्नपक्ष इवाकाशात् पपात धरणीधरः ।। 5.57.31 ।।।।
transliteration: harṣeṇāpūryamāṇo 'sau ramye parvatanirjhare ।chinnapakṣa ivākāśāt papāta dharaṇīdharaḥ ।। 5.57.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Feeling very happy at heart all the vanara leaders gathered around Hanuman. They stood motionless with extreme happiness.
